summary: A player within 20' (or the caster) becomes Insubstantial for 30 seconds; if self-cast, the caster may exit at any time.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: When cast on another player: Insubstantial for 30 seconds with no early exit. May also be used to protect an ally.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: When cast on self; may end it at any time with the Insubstantial exit incantation.

termination.note: Only if cast on self: the caster may end the Insubstantial State at any time with the exit incantation for Insubstantial.

clarifications.text: When cast on self, the caster may end the Insubstantial State early using the Insubstantial exit incantation.

open_questions: N1 only grants early exit when self-cast; a target other than the caster apparently may not exit early even if willing (Insubstantial's general exit rule needs them to have caused it).
